description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to leave entitlements and usage reports in the OrangeHRM leave management module. It extends a date range filter and includes properties for filtering by leave type, job title, employee numbers, subunit, location, and inclusion criteria for employees (current, past, or both). It also uses a trait for subunit ID chain handling.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for filtering leave entitlement and usage report searches based on various criteria such as leave type, employee info, and organizational units.
